subject: Spend cap: verified on API backends; two gaps for you
body: Tests in tests/test_llm_backends.py show Budget.max_cost_usd stops AnthropicLLM and OpenAIResponsesLLM (complete and complete_with_reasoning): the call after the cap is crossed raises BudgetExceeded before any HTTP request. Two gaps, both in your area, not fixed by me: (1) OpenAICompatLLM (the Modal vLLM dev target) charges cost 0.0, so the dollar cap can never stop it; Modal GPU time is not counted anywhere. It needs either a per-token price for the served model or a wall-clock/GPU-seconds charge. (2) check_spend() reads cost_usd without the lock and charge() runs after the response, so with N worker threads spend can overshoot by up to N x the largest single call (about N-1 extra calls). Also check_spend() does not look at max_calls or max_seconds; only exhausted() does, and callers must poll it.
